title: World Tree Map

bundledDerivatives.conversionCommand: pnpm dlx sharp-cli@5.2.0 -i Palworld-1.0-World-Tree-Map-8192.png -o world-tree-2048.webp -f webp -q 90 --effort 6 resize 2048 2048 --fit fill --kernel lanczos3
pnpm dlx sharp-cli@5.2.0 -i Palworld-1.0-World-Tree-Map-8192.png -o world-tree-4096.webp -f webp -q 90 --effort 6 resize 4096 4096 --fit fill --kernel lanczos3

attribution: Palworld and the World Tree map are copyright Pocketpair, Inc. T_TreeMap extracted directly from the owner's installed Palworld build.
sourceNoticeSummary: The source texture T_TreeMap was extracted from the owner's installed Palworld Xbox build (1.10.1283.0). The DT_WorldMapUIData Tree row supplies the game's World Tree map bounds; the game's MainMap row matches the owner-validated Palpagos telemetry projection exactly, so both rows share the same world reference frame. The raster transform is mathematically verified by round-trip unit tests; geographic/live-player validation is pending UAT (projection status: pending-geographic-validation).
